sections.value:
**Performance: PASS WITH NOTES**, round 2 (final under C34), at `028d340f8e4dcb51c9e44aff4247891c0e9cf7d7`.

**Delta verified:** the Stop wrapper uses builtin `umask 077`, one private `mktemp -d` directory for reply/answer/stderr, and one EXIT cleanup invocation. This replaces the existing mktemp-file/cleanup pair; it does not add another process per stop. Recursive cleanup now walks that small private directory. The one `pij-rs` invocation, candidate RPC gate, watchdog bounds and fd3 closures are unchanged.

Display-state privacy uses Rust filesystem operations, **not an external chmod launch**. Each non-final state write now ensures/inspects its directory, conditionally tightens a laxer mode, attempts stale-temp removal, creates a new 0600 temp file, writes and renames it; failure adds a temp-unlink attempt. The metadata check is per state write, not inside the 2ms ordering-read loop, and chmod occurs only when group/other permission bits are present. CI confirms 0700/0600, tightening an existing 0755 directory, and Stop-directory removal.

The skill's inline quoted-send versus output-file/no-stdin wording is corrected without runtime work.

**Round-1 P213-N001 remains a named C34 follow-up**, now explicitly in Known limits. No change to one host-owned display exec per flush of every Claude reply, linear seat scaling, the 2ms ordering poll with a 1s deadline, growing hidden-block state or aborted-file retention. The cost section no longer labels 16 flushes/3s a universal ceiling. Daemon counters and the six daemon spawn guards still exclude these host-owned launches; the sampler's hook rows remain lower bounds. The longer-lived Stop watchdog sleep qualification is also retained.

No new periodic loop, launch site or RPC introduced by this delta; the added cost is per-write filesystem metadata/cleanup. No normal-use performance blocker established.

**Exact-head CI:** [42754075360](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42754075360), Rust job `129624245202`, successful-upload artifact **13735610285**, matching head metadata: **2,400 executed passed**, zero failures/errors; six skips separately reported by nextest. JUnit names both new permission/cleanup tests and the existing ordering, installed-script, stdout-EOF and six spawn-guard cases. Node22/24, Rust lint and final delivers succeed; worktree clean and matching GitHub head/CLEAN.

No local build/test/probe, hook install/reload, live settings/transcript read or synthetic traffic. **The after-deploy reading with genuine Claude text traffic remains owed; no new runtime measurement is claimed.**
